# Milira
Milira have wings that they can extend and fold. They are sensitive to high temperatures.
They take [color=#ffa500]15% more blunt and heat damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]10% more slashing and piercing damage[/color], but [color=#1e90ff]30% less cold damage[/color].
Ordinary armor and hardsuits prevent Milira from extending their wings freely, but special armor designed for them allows them to spread their wings and fly.
